stories.title: Nations League: Klopp-Einstand mit Enthusiasmus, Fehlern und Remis in den Niederlanden

en.title: Nations League: Klopp's debut with enthusiasm, mistakes and draw in the Netherlands
en.summary: Jürgen Klopp's first match as Germany coach appeared heading toward victory until the Netherlands equalized in stoppage time against an enthusiastic but error-prone German team.

stories.title: Netanjahu-Rede bei UN - Dutzende Diplomaten verlassen Saal

en.title: Netanyahu speech at UN - Dozens of diplomats leave hall
en.summary: Dozens of diplomats walked out when Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu took the podium at the United Nations. Netanyahu responded sharply and defended military operations in the Middle East.

stories.title: Nations League: Deutschland remis gegen Niederlande bei Debüt von Jürgen Klopp

en.title: Nations League: Germany draws with Netherlands in Jürgen Klopp's debut
en.summary: Germany came close to defeating the Netherlands through effort and commitment in Klopp's first match, but the Dutch equalized with a late cross, earning praise from Klopp.

stories.title: Nations League, 1. Spieltag: Deutschland spielt im ersten Spiel unter Jürgen Klopp unentschieden

en.title: Nations League, matchday 1: Germany draws in first game under Jürgen Klopp
en.summary: Germany's national team missed out on victory against the Netherlands in Klopp's opening fixture when Cody Gakpo scored an equalizer late in the match.

stories.title: Frankreich: Emmanuel Macron will Truppen zum Schutz von Energieinfrastruktur entsenden

en.title: France: Emmanuel Macron wants to send troops to protect energy infrastructure
en.summary: President Emmanuel Macron announced plans to deploy soldiers and defense systems to the Yanbu oil port. He warned about growing threats from Russia and the impact of conflicts on energy prices.

stories.title: Benjamin Netanyahu: Etliche Delegierte verlassen vor Rede bei der Uno-Vollversammlung den Saal

en.title: Benjamin Netanyahu: Several Delegates Leave Hall Before Speech at UN General Assembly
en.summary: Dozens of delegates walked out during Benjamin Netanyahu's speech at the UN General Assembly to protest Israel's actions in Gaza. Netanyahu responded with sharp criticism of the protesters, particularly targeting New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani.

stories.title: UN-Generalversammlung: Netanjahu rechtfertigt Kriegsführung – viele Delegierte verlassen Saal

en.title: UN General Assembly: Netanyahu defends military operations – many delegates leave hall
en.summary: Benjamin Netanyahu defended Israel's military operations in the Middle East before the United Nations. Numerous UN delegates departed the assembly hall during his address.

stories.title: Problematischer Name: Rennpferd muss wegen Hitler-Bezug umbenannt werden

en.title: Problematic Name: Racehorse Must Be Renamed Due to Hitler Reference
en.summary: A horse owner and breeder has named a racehorse with references to Hitler, including names such as "Austrian Painter" and "My Struggle". A formal complaint has been filed against the owner.

stories.title: Liveticker: Nations League: Live: Niederlande gegen Deutschland

en.title: Live ticker: Nations League: Live: Netherlands vs Germany
en.summary: Germany plays the Netherlands in Amsterdam in a Nations League match, marking the first international game under new head coach Jürgen Klopp.

stories.title: Pressefreiheit in den USA: CNN, MS NOW und »Politico« berichten wieder aus dem Weißen Haus

en.title: Press freedom in the USA: CNN, MS NOW and "Politico" report again from the White House
en.summary: Three US media outlets that have faced Trump's disapproval have regained access to work at the White House after previously being denied entry despite a court ruling.

stories.title: USA-Newsblog: Reporter haben wieder Zugang zum Weißen Haus

en.title: USA news blog: Reporters regain access to the White House
en.summary: A judge's ruling determined that the exclusion of CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House was likely unconstitutional, and access was eventually restored after an initial denial.

stories.title: Donald Trump und die Pressefreiheit: CNN, Politico und MS NOW haben nun doch wieder Zugang zum Weißen Haus

en.title: Donald Trump and press freedom: CNN, Politico and MS NOW now have access to the White House again
en.summary: A court ruled in favor of three US media outlets' right to access the White House, though reporters were initially denied entry before eventually being allowed in hours later.

stories.title: Unternehmen: Starbucks schließt 250 Filialen in Nordamerika

en.title: Business: Starbucks closes 250 locations in North America
en.summary: The US coffee chain is closing unprofitable stores as part of cost-cutting measures, with closure costs reaching 300 million dollars.

stories.title: USA: Ausgesperrte Journalisten von CNN, MS Now und „Politico“ dürfen nun doch wieder ins Weiße Haus

en.title: USA: Journalists from CNN, MS Now and "Politico" barred from White House now permitted to return
en.summary: A federal judge halted the exclusion of three news outlets from White House access after journalists from these organizations were initially denied entry.

stories.title: Wall Street: US-Börsen schließen kaum verändert – Zinssorgen belasten Anleger

en.title: Wall Street: US stock markets close nearly unchanged – interest rate concerns weigh on investors
en.summary: US markets remained largely flat amid concerns over inflation, oil price uncertainty, and government finances, with investors monitoring outcomes from Xi and Trump discussions.

stories.title: Konsumgüter: Capri-Sun-Eigentümer Hans-Peter Wild steigt mit 85 wieder ins Geschäft ein

en.title: Consumer goods: Capri-Sun owner Hans-Peter Wild returns to active business at 85
en.summary: The billionaire resumed involvement in daily operations of the Baden-based beverage company following the chief executive's departure, as the manufacturer faces several challenges.
